rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something lasts or remains true for a long time.

example.english: This shop has been enduringly popular with local residents.
example.traditional: 呢間鋪頭長期受街坊歡迎。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 coeng4 kei4 sau6 gaai1 fong1 fun1 jing4

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on something remaining continuously true, such as staying popular throughout a period.

example.english: This drama has been enduringly popular since it first aired.
example.traditional: 呢套劇由開播到而家，一直都咁受歡迎。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 kek6 jau4 hoi1 bo3 dou3 ji4 gaa1 jat1 zik6 dou1 gam3 sau6 fun1 jing4
